description: This file defines a GitHub reporter for Playwright test results, including classes for logging and reporting test failures, slow tests, and summaries, with integration for GitHub Actions annotations.

classes.name: GitHubLogger
classes.description: A logger class that outputs GitHub Actions annotations to stdout with different log levels.

classes.name: GitHubReporter
classes.description: A custom Playwright test reporter that outputs annotations and summaries suitable for GitHub Actions, extending TerminalReporter.

methods.name: workspaceRelativePath
methods.description: Converts an absolute file path to a path relative to the GITHUB_WORKSPACE environment variable.
